answer: Reaching the ivory of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The ember lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the violet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
